Author: Fae Nightwolf
Name: Fae Nightwolf's Controller Additions
Punchline: Clock spot coordination and controller-based clock spot targeting.
Description: Automatically seats your party into clock spot positions (with role priority and encounter-specific layouts for FRU and TOP), lets you rearrange them by dragging slots, and prompts the party with a clickable link when entering an instance. Numpad1-8 can be bound to a controller to soft/hard target whoever is standing at a given clock position.
